title: Nako Renderer Cast-Safe Transport
problem: Nako-to-Nako casting can queue direct-play renderer commands, but non-direct remux/HLS renderer playback lacks a cast-safe media transport distinct from browser playback tickets and bearer control auth.
gates: cargo nextest run -p nako-api -E 'test(public_openapi) | test(admin_contract) | test(sdk)' --no-fail-fast

evidence.summary: Opened the Nako renderer cast-safe transport lane and ADR 0041, separating renderer-scoped media tickets from browser playback tickets while keeping Public Client renderer control on bearer-authenticated routes.

Added characterization tests for the current direct-only renderer transport gap, bearer-only Nako renderer registration, and browser-ticket response scope, proving remux/HLS renderer play and cast-ticket media auth still need the new transport primitive.

continue_policy.notes: Run NRCT-030 next to implement the renderer transport ticket service, then add the safe command transport envelope before opening Chromecast/DLNA/AirPlay workstreams.
